description: Federal Register documents: final and proposed rules, notices and presidential documents by words and agency (SEC, CFTC, Fed, Treasury, CFPB, FDA and more), with comment deadlines, effective dates and abstracts. Can list only rules still open for comment.

agency.description: One of: sec, cftc, fed, treasury, occ, cfpb, fdic, irs, ftc, fcc, epa, fda, faa, doe, ferc, bis, ofac, hhs.

open_for_comment.description: Only those whose comment period has not closed.

query.description: Words to find, e.g. "climate disclosure" or "stablecoin".

since.description: Published on or after this date.

type.description: Final rules, proposed rules, notices or presidential documents; default all.

name: federal_rules

outputSchema.description: rows are documents in the order of columns, newest first

title: Federal Register rules
